WITH invoice_aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_quantity,
    (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / SUM(derived_total_cost) AS cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_of_avgs
  FROM invoice_aggregates
)
SELECT 
  ia.invoice_number,
  ia.avg_quantity,
  ia.cost_ratio,
  ia.avg_quantity - oa.avg_of_avgs AS quantity_diff
FROM invoice_aggregates ia
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE ia.avg_quantity > oa.avg_of_avgs
ORDER BY quantity_diff DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity (VARCHAR(50)) contains numeric values or NULLs and can be cast to DECIMAL without error
SUM(derived_total_cost) is non-zero for all invoices returned (no division by zero)
